$comment: Declared versions NOT published from this repository, each with the reason.
State is computed from this repository's git tags. a1 and a2 were published
from dotmac_starter_mt and their tags stay there permanently.
The 0.1.0a13 row that sat here between the declaration and the publication
was removed by the RECORDER, as a8 through a12 were — the gesture a human
forgot twice (a4 by six silent hours, a7 loudly at every open pull request)
is now the verify run's own last act.
0.1.0a3 is published and permanently unpinnable; 0.1.0a4 and 0.1.0a5 are
published, verified, and refused for adoption; 0.1.0a6 through 0.1.0a12
remain published and verified; 0.1.0a13, 0.1.0a14 and 0.1.0a15 are published
and independently verified, and 0.1.0a15 is the version to pin until 0.1.0a16 is verified. All of them live in
docs/published-versions.json,
each superseding disposition APPENDED to its original record rather than
replacing it.
A row here and a row in docs/published-versions.json are never both true
about one version at once, and
test_the_ledger_and_the_published_record_never_claim_the_same_version states
that over the two FILES so it holds even in a tagless checkout.
NOT EMPTY: 0.1.0a16 is the tree's current declaration, derived as the
successor of the highest version in docs/published-versions.json
(0.1.0a15). main's bytes stopped being a15's the moment PR #69 (cancel_plan
decides "no rollout exists" under the target and plan locks) landed after
a15 was tagged, so a bare 0.1.0a15 declaration would misname the tree's
current bytes as a15's own. It is not yet built, tagged, released or
verified; this row exists only so the declared-publication gate can account
for it, and it is removed, without ever having named a real release, the
moment 0.1.0a16 is verified and tagged or the tree bumps past it.

0.1.0a16.reason: Declared as the successor of the published floor 0.1.0a15 (see docs/published-versions.json), per this same file's own prior statement of the next number. Allocation of the name only: no build, tag, release run or verify run has occurred for 0.1.0a16. This row exists only so the declared-publication gate can account for the declaration; it is removed, without ever having named a real release on its own, the moment a release run tags and verifies it.
